{{Top|leg}}
The '''Katarn''' was a style of [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilt]] that was invented by [[Kyle Katarn]]. It was later used by other [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi students]] who trained under [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|202|Katarn (1)}}</ref>
